mapper.insert: insert into prediction_task ( task_no, parent_task_id, task_round, warehouse_id, metric_code, data_source_type, target_type, algorithm_code, algorithm_name, train_start_time, train_end_time, forecast_start_time, forecast_end_time, based_on_actual_end_time, forecast_days, sample_size, trigger_type, adjust_status, status, risk_level, requested_by, requested_at, completed_at, summary, remark ) values ( #{taskNo}, #{parentTaskId}, #{taskRound}, #{warehouseId}, #{metricCode}, #{dataSourceType}, #{targetType}, #{algorithmCode}, #{algorithmName}, #{trainStartTime}, #{trainEndTime}, #{forecastStartTime}, #{forecastEndTime}, #{basedOnActualEndTime}, #{forecastDays}, #{sampleSize}, #{triggerType}, #{adjustStatus}, #{status}, #{riskLevel}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{summary}, #{remark} )
mapper.select: select * from prediction_task order by requested_at desc, id desc

select count(*) from prediction_task pt left join warehouse w on w.id = pt.warehouse_id
where pt.task_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(w.warehouse_name, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(pt.risk_level, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(cast(pt.forecast_days as char), '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(date_format(pt.forecast_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(date_format(pt.forecast_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(date_format(pt.requested_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(pt.target_type, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
select * from prediction_task where id = #{id} limit 1
